a: Class diagrams show classes, fields, methods, and relationships.
Sequence diagrams show messages between objects over time.
An entity is a thing stored as a table in relational design.
Relationships connect entities: one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many.
A monolith is one deployable unit containing many features.
Microservices split features into independently deployable services.
Event-driven systems communicate by publishing and consuming events.
CQRS separates read models from write models.
Cache-aside: app reads cache, on miss loads DB and fills cache.
Message queues decouple producers and consumers asynchronously.
